title: Exceptionally Unique Home in Sea Girt, New Jersey
description:
Presented by Ward Wight Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to http://s.sir.com/2mcrRR8

If you are looking for more than a 50' lot on the oceanfront in Sea Girt without a road or boardwalk to slow you down look no further! This is Sea Girt living and nature at its best where this unique property meets sand & sea. A one of a kind home offering three levels of living with disappearing walls of glass capturing unobstructed ocean views to the north and south. This is your opportunity to make this house your home or build your very own, and either way, you'll have the opportunity to indulge in a fabulous lifestyle in one of the most sought after communities along the Atlantic.
